sanskrit: sakalo niṣkalo'nantaḥ svecchānantarakāryakṛtbhogināṃ bhuktaye viśvaṃ vicitraṃ kurute śivaḥyathā tadvajjagaccitraṃ citrādbījānna śaṅkarātdṛṣṭaṃ tantusamākhyātamupādānamacetanamjñānakriye maheśasya parityajya na kāraṇamphalaṃ ca karmataḥ puṃsāṃ kimatreśvarakāritākarmaiva kṛṣyādikarmavat kāryajanakamaṅgīkṛtamiti kimanyadanumīyatekṛṣyādivat tu kartāraṃ prajñāvantamapekṣatesiddhasādhyatā | tatra dṛṣṭe sati nādṛṣṭakalpanā yuktetipumbhireva bhaved bījaṃ kiṃ hareṇeti tannahitataḥ kalādikāryasya nityotpādaḥ prasajyatesaṃbandhamātrasya bhāvāt | kalādikāryakaraṇotpāde satyanirmokṣaprasaṅgaḥyena nākasmikaṃ kāryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kvacana kiñcanayena nākartṛkaṃ kāryaṃ saṃbhavatītyuktamtasmād yoge viyoge vā maheśaḥ kāraṇaṃ tayoḥparameśvara eva, nānyaḥsvabhāva eva vaktavyo gatvā dūramapi tvayābahvadṛṣṭaṃ kalpitaṃ bhaviṣyatītivyāpāraḥ paranunnasya svatantrasyāthavā budhāḥsvatantraṃ kāryakṛd yasmānnopādānamacit kvacitprajñāvān prerakastasya yaḥ sa vijñeya īśvaraḥpravartate yadudrekād divākāle niśānvitesāmarthyalakṣaṇānmāyāto jagatkaraṇāya pravartate, iti neśvaro'nyaḥudreke kāraṇaṃ tasya nānyadasti maheśvarātato'nyathānupapattyā jñānātiśayayuktaḥ parameśvara evodrede tasyāḥ kāraṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parātmano maheśāttu dṛkkriyāśaktiśālinaḥutpatsyate tato'nyena jagadīśena kiṃ phalamcidacidviśvasaṃbhūtirātmano yadi so'pi hikāryāṇāṃ mūrtiviśeṣā hemamṛdādijanyaghaṭādīnāṃ siddhā yataḥviruddhāvekakālasthau dharmāvekāśrayaṃ gatauupādānatvato mṛdvat paramātmā na cetanaḥkāraṇatvāt | cetanatve vā nopādānakāraṇatvamitiacitprasavadharmī yat paramātmā mṛdādivatsvakāryaniṣpattaye mṛdādivad buddhimatkartṛpreritatvamasyābhyupagantavyamtasmād bhoktā jagadbījaṃ maheśaścāpi śaktimānsarvajñānakriyārūpā śaktirekaiva śūlinaḥna vāstavo jñānakriyāśaktyorbhedaḥ, api tu kalpita evakriyayā malinān puṃso niruṇaddhi maheśvaraḥniyamitāṃśca karmavipākānusāreṇa prerayatitatasteṣāṃ ca nunnānāṃ patyā saṃjāyate bhṛśamkāryakāraṇasaṃbandhayogyatotpādanameveśvarapreraṇamucyateśuddhāśuddhādhikārasthe vidyeśe'nanta ātmanijagatkaroti patiḥ | yacchūyate - vidyārājādhirājeśo jagad bhrāmayatīcchayā itijagatānena saṃyojya tān puṃso lolikāvataḥsādhanākārāṃ sthitiṃ karotīśvaraḥsthityante so'pi saṃsāre viśramārthaṃ pradhāvatāmtataḥ sarvopasaṃhāraṃ vidhatte bhagavānitivāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca svato'bhinnāpi sā tridhāsarvajñānakriyārūpā śaktirekaiva śūlinaḥ (mo0 25 ) iti na doṣaḥ kaścitityevaṃ devadevasya sarvakartṛtvamīritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvajñatvasiddhirityuktaṃ prākupādānanimittaistu phalena ca samanvitamupādānanimittaistu phalena ca samanvitaḥitthaṃ sarvārthakāritvād dvirūpā śaktirātmaniyayā yukto maheśānaḥ sarvaṃ vetti karoti cana kalāpiṇḍasaṃbaddhaḥ saṃbaddho'sau yathā paśuḥpaśuvat kalādyātmakaśarīrābhāvānniṣkalo bhagavānityuktaṃ prāknanvasya niṣkalatve tu na jñānaṃ nāpi kartṛtājñānādyabhāvaḥcidvyaktyarthaṃ kalāyogamapekṣete susaṃsthitevyañjakāpekṣe iti sarvadā sarvārthetadā'sau jāyate paśuḥkalādiyogād devadattādivadīśvaraḥ paśuḥ prasajyatekalāḥ sṛṣṭvāpi tadyuktaḥ kāryakṛd yadyasau tataḥkarotītyucyatetasmādalaṃ prasaṅgena bhogamokṣaprasādhakaḥsadaivārādhyo nānyaḥ, ityuktaḥ sasādhano bhogaḥmalādipāśavicchittiḥ sarvajñānakriyodbhavaḥpaścātmā mocyamānatvāt karmakārakamiṣyateastvātmanīno mokṣo hi bhogavat pudgalastataḥsarvajñatādirūpāvāptitaḥ svātmakartṛka eva mokṣo neśvarakartṛkaḥavive(ko? kā)'vasāyotthamajñānaṃ vinivartatesvakāraṇanivṛttyaiva tannivarteta nānyathāathātmadharmo bhāvaḥ syāt tucchatve tannivartatenivartyatve nātmadharmaḥ(syāt?) tadanādinirodhakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maheśamalamāyādivaśago'ṇuḥ sa cātmanāasyātmamocane śaktirvidyate na yataḥ svayamna puṃsāṃ mocane śaktiḥ pāśānāmapi vidyateśiva eva tadā'pi nivartakatvāt puṃbhyo mokṣada iti dṛṣṭe sati nādṛṣṭakalpanetijñatvakartṛtvayorvyaktiṃ pāśāḥ kurvantyanekadhāsvākārarañjitāṃ pāśāḥ pāśavṛttyanurāgiṇīmtayorvyaktiṃ prakurvanti niḥsaṃjñatvād bhaveritāḥpāśābhibhāvikā śaktiḥ siddhānāṃ dṛkkriyābhidhāpaśoriva pāśavyaṅgyā śarīrādāvātmagrahānurāgaṃ bhajatena cotpannairvinaṣṭairvā pāśaiḥ sā bhidyate yataḥsiddhaśaktiḥ, pāśapralaye'pyavikṛtenaiva svarūpeṇeśvaraśaktivadavasthānātśaktiḥ sā sarvaviṣayā na tenaivā'lpagocarāpaśuśaktivat kadācit kvacit kiñcidviṣayāsā ca vyaktyantarābhānna vyaktyantarabādhitāsiddhaśaktirbādhyate, śivasamatvena tasyāḥ prakarṣāntarābhāvātvyañjayanti na tāṃ pāśāḥ na ca bhūyo'bhibhūyatevyaṅgyavyaktirbhavet tāvad yāvad vyañjakasaṃnidhiḥabhivyaktikarī śaivī śaktistatsannidhānatāmitthaṃ vilakṣaṇāyāste siddhaśakterna pāśakāḥmokṣahetuḥyogo jñānaṃ tapaḥpūrvaṃ bhogasādhanaceṣṭitamcittam, jaḍatvātsutīvrā api nopāyāḥ svātmavicchedakārakāḥpariṇativiśeṣayogāt sa kadācit kasyacit kathañcicca || (ślo0 12 ) itirodhaśaktyadhikārasya kāle yāte svayaṃ tvaṇoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tannivṛttau svayaṃ śuddhā dṛkkriyāśaktirātmanisatyāṃ sthitau na saṃhāraṃ saṃhāre vā na ca sthitimtasmādavaśyaṃ malaparipāka eva śaktipāte karaṇaṃ vācyamcetanācetanāḥ sarve vaśyāstasyeti niścitamvidārya śaktiśūlena pāśajālamaṇoḥ śivaḥniṣkalān sakalānaṣṭau sargādāvicchayā patiḥkoṭisaptakasaṃkhyākān niṣkalān sakalānaṇūnmantrān vidadhātirudraśaktestu janyatvāt preryatvāccāpyadhastvidamdeśakṛtaḥ, vyāpakatvādātmanāmmāyordhvaṃ niṣkalatvādyaṃ māyoparyadhikārataḥkaraṇavarjitatvāccādhvaśāstre māyopari cintyatvena paṭhyatesarve cāvarajāḥ preryāḥ prerakā hyagrajāśca yetvadhobhāvānmantrāṇāmkalāḥ sṛṣṭvā maheśānastābhiḥ saṃyojya pudgalānmaṇḍalādhipatīnaṣṭau krodheśādyaṣṭakaṃ tathārudrāṇāmanugṛhṇātianugrahāya jantūnāṃ mantrāṇāṃ hi prayojakāḥ| na tvanantādīnāmiva mantrebhya ūrdhvaṃ sthitatvātagrajā niṣkalā mantrā ete caitadvilakṣaṇāḥnirviśeṣās-trayo'pyamī | mahālpayoniyogitvād viśiṣyante parasparam || itimāyāgarbhādhikāritvāt sakalatvācca śāsanebrahmādivanmāyātattvādadhaḥ kalādibhuvaneṣvavasthitiḥkalāyoge'pi no vaśyāḥ kalānāṃ paśusaṃghavatyatasteṣāṃ kālādīnāṃ krameṇoparyavasthitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āvirbhavatyadhīkāraḥ svaśaktivyaktyanantaramkālāntaraṃ pratīkṣatemantrakoṭyo'bhavan sapta sapteti niyamaḥ śruteḥvyāpāraparatantrāṇāmadhikārastu sāvadhiḥvakṣyamāṇā'vadhyanto'dhikāraḥutpatisthitisaṃhārasaṃrodhānugrahārthakṛtnyūnatvaṃ boddhavyamadhikārasya vaicitryādanugṛhya bhaveritamkṛtvādhikāramāyāti śivasāyujyamacyutamsiddhimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ maṇḍalāni ca sṛṣṭavānpūjāsthānāni navanābhādīni lokānāṃ hitārthamakārṣītvimuñcantītarān nunnā deśikasthena śambhunāśvaraprayojyatvādanugrahakaraṇatvaṃ sadaiva na kartṛtāsvaṃ svaṃ dadati jantūnāmīśaśaktipracoditāḥkurvantīti tatkartāro nānantādivadbhuvanasargādikartāraḥsānantāḥ svādhikārānte yānti muktiṃ hareraṇātmahātmanaḥ || sthāne śikhaṇḍinastvanyaṃ rudrāṇāṃ kurute śivaḥ || itipāratantryād vinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti patitulyatāmkṛtaprayojano'nanto mahā pralayopakrama eva patisamatvaṃ parāmuktiṃ gacchatītipuṃso mocitavānanyān mocayiṣyati cāparānmokṣaṃ karotītyarthaḥsvaśaktyopahṛtān puṃso mantrasādhanasādhyayāparipakvamalān puṃso mocayatītyuktammantreśaiḥ śāsitā rudrā rudrairdevāḥ suśāsitāḥmanuṣyairmānuṣāstadvad varṇasaṃsthā dvijottamaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhikāro gurutvena brāhmaṇasyaiva kīrtitaḥathācāryavaraḥ śrīmānagrajanmā supeśalaḥ (svā0 15|1) iti śruterbrāhmaṇasyaivayo vettyeva niyuktaḥ san guruṇā gaurave guruḥnātattvavidanabhyastakarmamārgo'pi no mataḥ || itiśaivamānamavindadbhiḥ paśumānānuvāsitaiḥanaikāntikatvātsvaprakāśamasau devaṃ prakāśayati śaṅkaramvakṣyamāṇavat svaprakāśasyeśvarasya buddhyupārohaḥ siddhyetna so'sthi kālo yatrāyamatrasthenānubhūyateupalabhyopalabdhṛtdaṃ tadabhāvādidaṃ tvasatpṛṣṭhasthā dvitīyā ṭippaṇī draṣṭavyā) buddhyadhyavasitatvāt puruṣo'pi cetyate itiviparītā ca buddhiḥ syād virodhaścāpi darśanesvarūpe'vasthānam (yo0 sū0 1| 3) itina prakāśayituṃ śaktā pāśatvānnigaḍādivatkhaḍge'bhīśumato yadvat tadaṃśasya tvasau bhramaḥ || itidāhābhibhavayoḥ kartuḥ prakāśāyābhivāñchitāḥnābhibhāvyābhirulkābhirdinakṛccābhibhāvakaḥśivaśaktikale śuddhe śivo dhyeya iti bruvancintayed budhaḥ (rau0 sū0 4 | 42-43) itina dhyeyo nāpi ca jñeyastasmādīśo'ṇubandhanaiḥśakyateśivaṃ śaktyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ paśyatyātmā gatāvṛtiḥna, draṣṭṛdraṣṭavyayordvayorapi vyāpakatvena tathā darśanāsaṃbhavātsakalāṇoḥ śivajñānaṃ dṛśyate tatkathaṃ bhavetśabdasyākāśavāyuhetutvena pāśatvāt kathaṃ tatastatpratipattiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samarthayati ciccakṣurnātaḥ kiñcid virudhyategamyate kāryataḥ khyātād vyakto dehe graho yathāpratimādāviva gamyatebhavaḥ prakāśaśūnyeṣu vyajyate kathamucyatena jaḍe cidrūpasyābhivyaktirupapadyata ityarthaḥsvaparātmaprakāśo'yaṃ niṣprakāśeṣu cidvatāmviśeṣasannidhāno'bhivyajyata ityadoṣaḥbogānte sādhakaḥ siddhiṃ tathaiva prāpnuyād dhruvamśivapadaparaiśvaryabhājo bhavanti ititeṣāmatulyabuddhitvāt kāryaṃ notpattumarhatiparameśvarasyaivetyabhyupagantavyamititeṣāmatulyabuddhitvāt kāmabhedo na durlabhaḥsiddhāste'to na kāmaistu bhedavadbhiḥ samanvitāḥteneha sarvakāryāṇāmutpattirna virudhyatepakṣagrahāsaṃbhavānnābhiprāyabheda iti na kāryānutpādadoṣaprasaṅgo'tranyūnatvānna ca sārvajñamakartṛtvāt paśuryathāpaśuvad bhavenmukta itianyathā kartṛtā na syādīśvarasyā'pi siddhavatīśvaro'pi sarvajñatvādasya sarvakartṛtā'nyathā na syāditi viśvānutpādaprasaṅgaḥkartṛtvasya na cābhāvaḥ sādhitatvāt tatastvasauvyajyate kartṛtā siddhe sarvatra jñānavanna cakartavyamiti saṃcintya siddho na karaṇīyaṃ karotītisiddhe vyaktā paśau neti viśeṣaḥ kastayoryadiko viśeṣaḥpravṛttiḥ sarvaniṣpattau vyaktirnānyā tu tadgatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvakṛtyapravṛttau vā nāsāvastīti varṇyatāmsarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvalakṣaṇataiva muktirabhyupagantavyāvimokṣe guṇasaṃkrāntāvīśo'nīśvaratāṃ vrajettyaktvā svaguṇinaṃ yānti na ca guṇyantaraṃ guṇāḥguṇasaṃkrāntyanupapatterna tayā śivasamatvamabhyupagantavyamitiprāguktadoṣaduṣṭātmā paramātmā yathā tathātatsiddhasyā'pi tadabhedāt prasajyata ityadvaitameva mokṣo bhavatāmekatvadarśanaṃ mukteḥ sādhanaṃ svātmabādhitamsādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ, sādhyasādhanabhāve vā'nekatvamitibhede sati pramāṇānāṃ pravṛttirnānyathā matāmuktvā yogaphalaṃ ramyaṃ bhogān sāṃsārikānapina ca tasmin apuruṣārthabhūte kasyacit pravṛttirupapadyatesvacaitanyavināśāya santaḥ santaḥ kathaṃ ca tejñānayogābhyāsādiprayāsaṃ kuryuḥviveko nāma vaidharmyād guṇānāṃ puruṣasya cakartṛprasavasaṃkīrṇadharmakā hi guṇā vayamtathā darśitadarśitve mithyādarśī pumān bhavetnīlopādhau himavati tatpratipattirmithyaiva | na ca mithyājñānānmokṣaḥ, ayuktatvātkartṛtvādi guṇā hyete guṇā nāhamitīdṛśīsvātmaviviktaguṇadraṣṭṛtve puruṣasya kalpyamāne vyāhatamanye guṇāḥ pumānanya iti no darśayanti tena cā'pi viṣayasteṣāmaṇurityuditaṃ purāyathoktapaśupāśeṣu sādhyasādhanavarjanātato'nyavādidṛṣṭayo'śreyaḥphalāḥ śreyo'rthibhiḥ parihāryāḥpaśupāśādivaiśiṣṭyaprakāśakamabādhitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: susaṃvādaṃ śaivāgamākhyaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣādivat kasya nābhimatamna ca svagocare tāsāṃ bādhate tatpramāṇatāmprāpyaprāpakatvena prāmāṇyameveti | etaccoktamasmābhiḥ sarvāgamaprāmāṇyena cānyena pramāṇena saṃruddhastasya gocaraḥparaśreyoheturvedavidbhiranyaiśca pramāṇametad grāhyamna tābhirabhibhāṣyābhiḥ sāmānyābhiśca bādhyateyathā meyaphale tāsāṃ tadanūdya prakāśatetasya meyaphalaṃ coktvā svaprameyaphalāśritamsarvābhirgocarīkartumaśakyam | ataḥ kathamaviṣaye bādhakatvaṃ tāsāṃ syātabhyanujñā viṣedho vā tena tāsu viniścitambrāhmīṃ na vā kuryācchaivīmeva niyogataḥ itianādikālasaṃsiddhaṃ tadguṇatve'pi śāṅkarena cāvihataśaktitvāt patyurbādhaṃ tadaśnutekintūktameva tatpramāṇyaṃ bhagavato'pratihataśaktitvena sarvottamatvātgrāhyaṃ tulyaphalatve'pi vimuktirdīkṣayaiva tatvidbān yatnamācaret | itisiddhirvyāpāranirmuktā muktirapyatiśāyinīdṛṣṭyantaraistulyaphalatve'pi na vikalpitā pravṛttiratretiātreyāya munīndreṇa ruruṇā saṃprakāśitausadyojyotistu saṃkṣepāt tāvetau paribaddhavānugrajyotirguruḥ śrīmān sarvavidyāsaritpatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00006 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
